plain: You can return anything within 30 days for a full refund.
legal: The Customer may return any item within thirty (30) days of purchase for a full refund.

plain: Items must be unused and in the original packaging.
legal: Returned items shall be unused and in their original packaging.

plain: You'll need the receipt to return something.
legal: Proof of purchase shall be required for any return.

plain: Return shipping is free for faulty items.
legal: Return shipping shall be free of charge for defective items.

plain: For other returns, you pay the shipping.
legal: For all other returns, the Customer shall bear the cost of return shipping.

plain: Underwear and earrings can't be returned for hygiene reasons.
legal: For reasons of hygiene, underwear and earrings shall not be eligible for return.

plain: Refunds take up to 10 business days to show up on your card.
legal: Refunds may take up to ten (10) business days to be credited to the Customer's card.

plain: If your order arrives late, you can ask for a shipping refund.
legal: If an order is delivered late, the Customer may request a refund of the shipping charges.

plain: Store credit never expires.
legal: Store credit shall not expire.

plain: We'll match a lower price from another store within 7 days of purchase.
legal: The Store shall match any lower price offered by another retailer within seven (7) days of purchase.

plain: Price matching doesn't apply to online marketplaces.
legal: Price matching shall not apply to prices offered on online marketplaces.

plain: The flight can be changed for a $50 fee.
legal: The flight may be changed upon payment of a fee of $50.

plain: Basic fares can't be changed or refunded.
legal: Basic fares are non-changeable and non-refundable.

plain: If we cancel your flight, you can choose a refund or a new flight.
legal: If the Airline cancels a flight, the Passenger may elect to receive either a refund or an alternative flight.

plain: Each passenger can bring one carry-on bag up to 8 kg.
legal: Each passenger may carry one (1) item of cabin baggage weighing no more than 8 kg.

plain: Checked bags over 23 kg cost extra.
legal: An additional charge shall apply to checked baggage exceeding 23 kg.

plain: Arrive at the gate at least 30 minutes before departure.
legal: Passengers shall present themselves at the boarding gate not less than thirty (30) minutes prior to departure.

plain: Hotel check-in is from 3 pm and check-out is by 11 am.
legal: Check-in shall be available from 3 pm, and check-out shall take place no later than 11 am.

plain: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before arrival.
legal: Reservations may be cancelled free of charge up to forty-eight (48) hours prior to arrival.

plain: Late cancellations are charged the first night.
legal: Late cancellations shall incur a charge equal to the rate for the first night.

plain: The gym membership costs $39 a month with a 12-month minimum.
legal: The gym membership shall cost $39 per month, subject to a minimum term of twelve (12) months.

plain: You can freeze your membership for up to 3 months a year.
legal: The Member may suspend the membership for up to three (3) months in any year.

plain: Guests must be accompanied by a member.
legal: Guests shall be accompanied by a Member at all times.

plain: Tickets are non-transferable.
legal: Tickets are non-transferable.

plain: If the concert is cancelled, you'll get your money back.
legal: In the event that the Concert is cancelled, ticket holders shall receive a full refund.

plain: If the concert is postponed, your ticket is valid for the new date.
legal: In the event that the Concert is postponed, tickets shall remain valid for the rescheduled date.

plain: Booking fees are not refundable.
legal: Booking fees shall be non-refundable.

plain: Children under 5 travel free.
legal: Children under the age of five (5) shall travel free of charge.

plain: The extended warranty adds 3 more years of coverage.
legal: The extended warranty shall provide coverage for an additional period of three (3) years.

plain: You can cancel the extended warranty within 30 days for a full refund.
legal: The Customer may cancel the extended warranty within thirty (30) days and receive a full refund.

plain: Repairs under warranty are done within 15 working days.
legal: Repairs under warranty shall be completed within fifteen (15) working days.

plain: If we can't repair it, we'll replace it.
legal: If the Product cannot be repaired, the Company shall replace it.

plain: The subscription box ships on the 10th of every month.
legal: The subscription box shall be dispatched on the tenth (10th) day of each month.

plain: Skip a month by changing your settings before the 1st.
legal: The Customer may skip a monthly delivery by amending the Customer's settings before the first (1st) day of the month.

plain: Loyalty points expire after 18 months.
legal: Loyalty points shall expire eighteen (18) months after they are earned.

plain: Points can't be used to pay for gift cards.
legal: Loyalty points shall not be redeemable for gift cards.

plain: Car rental requires a credit card in the driver's name.
legal: The rental of a vehicle shall require a credit card in the name of the driver.

plain: Drivers must be at least 21 years old.
legal: Drivers shall be at least twenty-one (21) years of age.

plain: Return the car with a full tank or pay a refueling fee.
legal: The vehicle shall be returned with a full tank of fuel, failing which a refueling charge shall apply.

plain: Each extra driver costs $12 per day.
legal: A charge of $12 per day shall apply for each additional driver.

plain: Smoking in rental cars results in a $250 cleaning fee.
legal: Smoking in any rental vehicle shall result in a cleaning fee of $250.

plain: Restaurant bookings are held for 15 minutes.
legal: Restaurant reservations shall be held for fifteen (15) minutes after the reserved time.

plain: Groups of 8 or more pay a 12% service charge.
legal: A service charge of 12% shall apply to parties of eight (8) or more guests.

plain: Tell us about allergies when you order.
legal: Customers shall inform staff of any allergies when placing an order.

plain: Prices on the menu include service.
legal: Menu prices are inclusive of service.

plain: Online orders over $25 get free delivery.
legal: Online orders exceeding $25 shall qualify for free delivery.

plain: Deliveries are made between 8 am and 6 pm.
legal: Deliveries shall be made between 8 am and 6 pm.

plain: Someone over 18 must sign for alcohol deliveries.
legal: Deliveries containing alcohol shall be signed for by a person aged eighteen (18) or over.

plain: Phone repairs come with a 90-day warranty.
legal: Phone repairs shall be covered by a warranty of ninety (90) days.

plain: We're not responsible for data lost during repairs.
legal: The Repairer shall not be liable for any loss of data occurring during repairs.

plain: Unclaimed repaired items will be disposed of after 60 days.
legal: Repaired items not collected within sixty (60) days shall be disposed of.

plain: The dry cleaner's liability is limited to 10 times the cleaning charge.
legal: The Dry Cleaner's liability shall be limited to ten (10) times the cleaning charge.

plain: Complaints should be made within 14 days of the service.
legal: Any complaint shall be made within fourteen (14) days of the date of service.

plain: Online purchases can be cancelled within 14 days without giving a reason.
legal: Online purchases may be cancelled within fourteen (14) days without the need to state any reason.

plain: The insurance policy covers theft but not loss.
legal: The insurance policy covers theft but does not cover loss.

plain: You must report theft to the police within 24 hours to make a claim.
legal: To be eligible to make a claim, the Insured shall report any theft to the police within twenty-four (24) hours.

plain: The excess for each claim is $150.
legal: An excess of $150 shall apply to each claim.

plain: Pre-existing conditions aren't covered.
legal: Pre-existing medical conditions shall not be covered.

plain: The policy starts at midnight on the date shown in your certificate.
legal: Cover under the policy shall commence at midnight on the date stated in the certificate of insurance.

plain: You have a 14-day cooling-off period after buying the policy.
legal: The Policyholder shall have a cooling-off period of fourteen (14) days following the purchase of the policy.
